architecture: CRNN (4-block Conv2d + GroupNorm(8, C) + BiLSTM(128) + Linear(320))
resize_policy: Bilinear interpolation resize to fixed (Height=64, Width=1024)
padding_policy: none (direct resize to target aspect ratio)
decode_method: Greedy CTC decoding (argmax per timestep -> collapse repeat characters -> drop blank token index 0)
supported_input_unit: text_line_crop (NOT intended to directly OCR an entire worksheet image without upstream layout/region segmentation)
split_method: Random split from Viet-Handwriting-OCR-v2 with seed=42 (image-disjoint: PASS; writer-disjoint: UNKNOWN)

metrics_clarification.overfitting_claim_correction: Previous claim of virtually zero overfitting (gap=0.00011) resulted from comparing metrics at different steps (step 16900 val vs step 18901 train). Re-evaluation on step 16900 shows true train CER of 0.0866 and val CER of 0.1120, yielding a normal generalization gap of ~0.0254 (2.54%).

smoke_test_scope: PACKAGE_SMOKE_TEST_SAMPLES (Mean CER on the 5 packaged smoke-test samples; not official validation CER or production accuracy)
sample_provenance: VALIDATION (All 5 packaged samples originate from the 500-sample validation set runs/audit/subset_full/val_manifest.json; paths retain upstream prefix images/train/ from raw parquet archive)

arithmetic_specific_evaluation.reason: General Vietnamese handwriting corpus contains 0 standalone arithmetic expressions in the validation set and only 1 in the 59,462 training samples. It is not an arithmetic worksheet dataset.

batch_inference.memory_safety: Processes inputs in chunks of batch_size to prevent OOM when handling 10-30 worksheet crops

mathvision_integration.role: Integration candidate for cropped text-line OCR within services/ai-service
mathvision_integration.conceptual_pipeline: worksheet image -> YOLO/layout detection -> text line crop -> CRNN OCR -> recognized string -> arithmetic parser -> rule engine
mathvision_integration.scope_limitation: CRNN OCR does NOT replace YOLO layout detection, deterministic grading rule engine, or teacher authority.
